	is_shown = { kehillah_review_reviewer_trigger = yes }
	is_valid = {
		custom_description = { text = KEHILLAH_REVIEW_REQ_NOT_REVIEWED NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_reviewed_works target = flag:work_authored_15 } } }
		custom_description = { text = KEHILLAH_REVIEW_REQ_MASTERED is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_15 } }
		custom_description = { text = KEHILLAH_REVIEW_REQ_WINDOW kehillah_review_haskamah_window_work_authored_15_trigger = yes }
		kehillah_review_can_haskamah_work_authored_15_trigger = yes
	}
	effect = {
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_review_work value = flag:work_authored_15 }
		trigger_event = kehillah_review.0001
	}
}

		kehillah_review_can_cherem_work_cochin_copper_plates_trigger = yes
